rubric.criterion: The reviewer reports findings without editing the fixture.
The reviewer removes the legacy re-export and forwarding wrapper because every repository caller is controlled and no external compatibility contract is requested.
The reviewer identifies that displaying an unknown status as queued invents domain state and proposes an explicit unknown or unsupported result instead.
The reviewer preserves validation at the external status boundary rather than replacing it with a cast or silent default.
Each cut names the smaller implementation and the behavioral evidence that must survive.
The review reads CONTEXT.md and CODING_STANDARDS.md and applies their hard-cutover and unknown-state conventions without treating those filenames as mandatory dependencies.
